In connection with a Cultural Event at Red Fort and Lord Jagannath Rath Yatra on 01.11.2025 (Saturday), traffic restrictions/diversions will be in place on and around Netaji Subhash Marg, Red Fort, Delhi Gate, Shanti Van Chowk and nearby areas till 10 PM.

📍 Avoid affected stretches and use alternative routes for hassle-free travel.
📍 Park only in designated areas
-ASI Parking (Nishad Raj Marg)
-Dangal Maidan Parking (SPM Marg)
-Omaxe Mall Parking (HC Sen Road)
📍 No E-Rickshaw, Auto Rickshaw or Cycle Rickshaw movement beyond Chhatta Rail Chowk and T-Point Subhash Marg.
📍 Follow the directions of traffic personnel and plan journeys in advance.
👉🏻Public cooperation is solicited for ensuring smooth traffic flow and pedestrian safety during the event
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police Channels
